# Universal Insulation Doctor

> Expert insulation and pest-resistant solutions for Hampton Roads homes, specializing in Pest Guard attic insulation, crawl space protection, and air duct cleaning.

Universal Insulation Doctor serves Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Norfolk, and surrounding areas with comprehensive insulation services. The company offers energy-efficient solutions including Pest Guard blown-in fiberglass insulation (R-49 attic, R-19 subfloor), professional insulation removal with HEPA filtration, air duct cleaning, and sanitization treatments to protect homes from moisture, pests, and allergens.
